explanations.INCREASE_SAVINGS: Your savings ratio is below the recommended threshold. Increasing your monthly savings can strengthen your financial safety buffer and improve your ability to achieve future goals.
explanations.REDUCE_EXPENSES: Your expenses consume a large portion of your income. Reducing unnecessary or discretionary spending can increase the amount available for savings, debt repayment and investments.
explanations.REDUCE_DEBT: Your debt burden is significant relative to your income. Prioritizing debt repayment, especially high-interest debt, can reduce financial risk and improve future cash flow.
explanations.MAINTAIN_STRATEGY: Your current savings, spending and debt indicators are within the configured healthy ranges. Continue monitoring your financial position and goals.
